## Area

- [ ] Host Capability Manifest
- [ ] Service Requirements Profile
- [ ] Evidence method or freshness
- [ ] Typed units or versions
- [ ] Compatibility matching
- [ ] Public/private disclosure
- [ ] Discovery and caching
- [ ] TOSCA, NetBox, NixOS or control-plane mapping
- [ ] Security or privacy

## Use case

Describe the host, service package, scheduler, catalogue or deployment tool that would use this behaviour.

## Current limitation

What would be difficult, ambiguous or unsafe under the current RFC?

## Proposed change

Provide the capability field, requirement rule, interface or conformance test you recommend.

## Example or fixture

Use sanitised data only. Do not include credentials, private addresses, unique hardware identifiers or internal topology.

## Interoperability and security effects

Explain compatibility, disclosure, trust-boundary or implementation consequences.

## References

Link relevant specifications, NixOS modules, TOSCA/NetBox concepts, issues or implementation documentation.
